subject: prd/prototype
statement: When the provider of an idea asks for a prototype, Pyxis shall build a prototype of the idea before the feature's PRD is authored.
rationale: "when we give an idea we can also prototype it first" (brainstorm:prototype#D-5)
fit_criterion: On a feature whose provider asked for a prototype, the draft's history shows the findings record committed before the first authored PRD content; on a feature whose provider did not ask, no prototype is built
